summary: Acquired and inventoried every vascular, optic and deep-limbic mesh the v8 plan needs from the already-owned BodyParts3D 4.0 archive. (1) Resolved 106 BP representation ids -> 106 FMA ids -> 133 distinct FJ element files via .bp3d-probe/isa_parts.txt + isa_elements.txt (0 unresolved, 0 missing from the zip: assets-src/bp3d/isa_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip, sha256 40665852c49f218326590e204db91064a1ecfc3c6f8cbd7bbbcaac62c7cd409e) and extracted the 122 not already on disk in one `tar -xf ... --strip-components=1` pass into the gitignored assets-src/bp3d/raw-vasc/ (122 .obj, 12.5 MB ASCII, 0 empty files). (2) Parsed every mesh with assets-src/bp3d/parse-objs.mjs and wrote assets-src/bp3d/raw-vasc/vasc-inventory.json (133 mesh records = 122 extracted + 11 reused from raw//raw-tel/ and re-measured only; 111,336 vertices / 188,482 faces; per-file size+sha256, vertices/faces/normals/degenerate count, bbox mm + extent + centroid, raw mm->au bbox, measured side, mirror pair, atlas-record mapping; plus the full 272-row BP/FMA/FJ concept table and a 106-row FMA->BP resolution index). (3) Wrote docs/VASC_INVENTORY.md: licence statement (BodyParts3D 4.0, DBCLS, CC BY 4.0, verbatim credit line, no new source/download), coordinate frame, the complete per-mesh table with the atlas record each element feeds (vasc-internal-carotid-artery is the only trunk left deliberately unmapped -> source only), a 9-row geometry sanity table proving the plan's BP ids really are the arteries they claim (basilar midline over the pons z band 1502.6-1532.3 mm; vertebral tops meet the basilar bottom at 1506 mm; ICA tops reach the suprasellar cistern at 1537.7 mm; ACA/ICA/MCA/SCA pairs mirror-exact within 0.01 mm; PCom links carotid to PCA; P1 8.6 mm vs P2 36.9 mm), the laterality audit (BP3D's per-side labels agree with geometry everywhere; FJ1818/FJ1815 are the right halves of chiasm/mammillary body and FJ1825 already spans both sides, FJ1672+FJ1844 are two decimations of the same basilar concept), the bake-budget table (all vascular 107 files/136,244 faces; the named-record subset 57 files/34,984 faces; MCA tree + context 50 files/101,260; optic pathway 8 files/14,928), and the optic + deep-limbic inventory. FOUND: complete retino-geniculate chain meshes (optic nerve 2 files/side, chiasm, tract) + LGN/MGN already baked; mammillary body per side (FJ1768/FJ1815); septum of telencephalon FJ1832 as the septal-region mesh (caveat stated); stria terminalis FJ1778/FJ1825. ABSENT from the archive (record-only, as the plan already budgets): nucleus accumbens, claustrum, dentate gyrus, hippocampal subfields (subiculum, CA1-CA4) - verified by exhaustive search of the archive's own 2,905-id concept list, stated explicitly in the doc. Verification: an independent self-check re-read all 133 files from disk and re-derived size, sha256, vertex/face counts, bounding boxes, totals and the laterality rule from the raw bytes - all PASS; `npm run validate` exit 0 (0 errors; the single non-blocking W1 warning is src/data/structures-pending/vasculature.json created by the parallel content-authoring task, outside this task's scope, and it is a file-placement warning not a data error); `npm run check` exit 0; `npm run verify:pipeline` exit 0 with the unchanged baseline 106/106 parts / 570,096 triangles; git status shows no file of mine outside docs/VASC_INVENTORY.md and assets-src/bp3d/raw-vasc/.
